sloka: निरीक्षमाणः सहसा महात्मा सर्वम् वनम् निर्झर कन्दराम् च ।उद्विग्न चेताः सह लक्ष्मणेन विचार्य दुःखोपहतः प्रतस्थे ॥४-१-१२६॥
transliteration: nirīkṣamāṇaḥ sahasā mahātmā sarvam vanam nirjhara kandarām ca ।udvigna cetāḥ saha lakṣmaṇena vicārya duḥkhopahataḥ pratasthe ॥4-1-126॥

translations.english: The great Rama was overcome with grief while scanning the entire forest with its streams and caves. Engrossed in her thoughts, dejected at heart and inflicted with pain, he set both, accompanied by Lakshmana.
